svg.title: Why does protein–light correlation increase?
svg.desc: Illustrative traces show total protein as a phase-conditioned repeatable waveform plus residual variation. The law of total variance gives Var(F)=S+N. Periodic protein–light correlation exactly factors into waveform shape R_shape times the square root of the coherent variance fraction S/(S+N). The plotted traces are schematic, not simulation results.
svg.text: Separate the repeatable daily response from variability at the same light phase.
square root of the coherent variance fraction
Gong & Peskin · Coherent response and residual fluctuations in a light-driven circadian oscillator.
Illustrative traces, not simulation output. The conditional decomposition and correlation identity are exact.
